pr.title: Star items and show only the starred ones

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_starred.sql adds starred NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/starred.test.js 'AC-1' checks that the three rows seeded by 0001 read 0 after 0002, and that the value 2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' expects ["First item","★ Second item","Third item"]. src/index.js:15 adds the star before the title.
test 'AC-3' stars 3 and 1 and expects only those two, in id order, with status 200. The query keeps ORDER BY id.
test 'AC-4' checks both / and /?show=all give the full list in id order. The old tests in test/index.test.js are untouched.
test 'AC-5' checks the 'Starred only' link on / and the 'All items' link on the starred view.
test 'AC-6' requests Starred, none, an empty value and __proto__. Each answers 400 with no <li>. Object.hasOwn guards the lookup.

traffic/routes.json now lists /?show=starred. Test 'AC-7' asserts it. The traffic Worker passes the path, query included, to the app. test/traffic.test.js now records the query. tests/traffic-config.test.sh covers a query route passing and a fragment or space failing.

lenses.note: The change matches the spec's intent. It adds nothing beyond the ask except the checker's query-string relaxation. The PR discloses that relaxation, and AC-7 needs it.

Both decisions are followed: the order is by id with no starred-first sort, and the view is a query parameter with no cookie. All four rows of the states table have a test that checks the list, the message and the link. The Go line is dated and no commit edits an acceptance item.

Each AC and state test checks rendered output or status and would fail on broken code. I did not run the suite here. The vitest and Workers runtime run belongs to CI. No tests were deleted or loosened.
The README describes ?show=starred. CLAUDE.md and the README already say to add routes to traffic/routes.json, and this change does so.

The show parameter is checked against an own-property allowlist, so __proto__ is rejected. The SQL fragments are constants, and titles are still HTML-escaped. The empty show= value answers 400, which matches AC-6.
No injection path: the user-supplied value is only used as a key into a fixed map. The planted-instruction check found nothing.
The page is two bare HTML elements, a nav link and a list. No stylesheet, components or UI framework files are touched.
The page is two bare HTML elements, a nav link and a list. There is no interactive flow beyond following a link, and the tests check both views.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims about the behaviour change, migration, traffic route, checker change and test change all match the diff. No assets merge is present.
